vibe: Calm, cinematic, futuristic, emotional, healing, spirituality, premium healthcare

body.usage: Navigation, body copy, buttons, small labels.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing, py-24 to py-32 for main sections
layout.grid_system: Bento grid with generous gap (gap-8 or gap-12) for 4D Framework and Programme sections

navigation.style: Transparent floating, centered, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/40), max-width 1280px.
navigation.behavior: Scroll-aware, slightly opaque on scroll down, fade-down entrance.

hero.overlay: Soft blur on edges, slight brightness reduction, bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-white/20 to-white
hero.headline_classes: font-serif text-[72px] md:text-[100px] lg:text-[140px] leading-[0.95] tracking-[-0.025em]
hero.cta_style: Large rounded-full pill, bg-black text-white px-8 py-4 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:scale-[1.03] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] transition-all duration-500

whatsapp_button.style: Persistent, floating bottom-right, z-50, rounded-full, high contrast black or dark grey to match minimal palette.

cards.style: Flat background or purely white, 1px subtle border (border-black/5), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.

motion.fade_up: 600-900ms ease-out, no bouncing. Opacity 0 to 1, translateY 20px to 0.
motion.hero_scroll: Slowly scales up content, video moves in parallax (slower than content).
motion.nav_scroll: Becomes slightly opaque/blurred as user scrolls past hero.

sections_required: About (ISKCON Navi Mumbai, BVCE, BAHRC, Swaayu Cancer Care Centre, SNJ origin)
Science (NCCN/ASCO/ESMO/SIO guidelines badges, FACT-G/HADS/FACIT/PSQI outcome tools)
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure React CRA, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, MongoDB are used as specified.
Do NOT use TypeScript or Vite; stick to .js/.jsx.
Load Google Fonts: Instrument Serif and Inter.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (e.g., WhatsApp, Arrow, Quotes).
For the hero video loop, strictly implement requestAnimationFrame for fading logic (0.5s in/out) without flashing.
Headings must use Instrument Serif, and body/buttons must use Inter.
Implement scroll-triggered fade-ups (600-900ms ease-out) using framer-motion for all sections.
For the hero headline 'Healing Beyond Medicine. Living Beyond Cancer.', italicize 'Medicine' and 'Cancer' in text-[#6F6F6F] using the <i> or <em> tag.
Display 4D Framework (Body, Mind, Intelligence, Soul) and 2H-2R-2L wellbeing model with bento-style cards using a 1px border of rgba(0,0,0,0.06).
Science section should cleanly display the mentioned guideline acronyms (NCCN, ASCO, ESMO, SIO) and outcome tools in a premium, airy grid.
Create placeholders or simple divs for map embeds in the Contact section.
Build a multi-page routing structure for Home, About, Programme, Science, People, Explore, Get Involved, Contact.
